description: PIMA Adapta. Impactos - Retroceso de la línea de costa en la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut Cartogràfic Valencià. Characterization of the retreat of the coastline due to climate change, if necessary adaptation measures are not used. The following climate scenarios are established: - Scenario 1: Year 2050 + RCP4.5. + 50th percentile decline - Scenario 2: Year 2050 + RCP4.5. + 95th percentile decline - Scenario 3: Year 2100 + RCP4.5. Coverage: Institut Cartogràfic Valencià. The portal shows the English title as "PIMA Adapta. Impacts - Retreat of the coastline in the Valencian Community" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut Cartogràfic Valencià. Its keywords include ICV_CLAS:Medio ambiente;Cambio climático, IDEV, Espanya, Comunitat Valenciana, Línea de costa, Climate change. The listing shows 2021-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
